output_path.description: Filesystem path where the merged JSON file must be written.

sources.description: List of source JSON files and the fields to extract from each.

path.description: Filesystem path to the source JSON file.

mappings.description: List of required field extraction rules for this source file.

from.description: JSONPath expression pointing to the field inside the source JSON.

to.description: Top-level key name in the output JSON where the extracted value will be placed.
